patterns.label: Research and briefing
patterns.description: Controls, risk, case analysis, philosophy, and structured learning work recur most often.

patterns.label: Product, game, and interface work
patterns.description: Design implementation, visual review, iteration, and project QA form the strongest build pattern.

patterns.label: Translation and language
patterns.description: Repeated language tasks suggest reusable tone, audience, and terminology preferences.

patterns.label: Technical and app help
patterns.description: Short troubleshooting and setup requests benefit from a trusted diagnostic checklist.

patterns.label: Health explainers
patterns.description: Recurring explanatory work benefits from a consistent evidence and uncertainty format.

patterns.label: Storage and desktop hygiene
patterns.description: The newest pattern is operational maintenance—the first automation Steward now owns.

opportunities.title: Long-session checkpoint
opportunities.summary: Capture decisions, changed files, validations, open risks, and the next step before a long agent task ends.
opportunities.evidence: A 10-task Codex sample had a median duration near 71 minutes and frequent multi-turn handoffs.

opportunities.title: Project observatory
opportunities.summary: Watch generated size, backup status, stale prototypes, and reproducible cleanup space across saved projects.
opportunities.evidence: 31 saved local projects were found; 23 are not Git repositories.
opportunities.timeSaved: Weekly review reduced to one brief

opportunities.title: Interface polish circuit
opportunities.summary: Turn screenshots, responsive checks, accessibility checks, builds, and visual review into one repeatable finish pass.
opportunities.evidence: 12 recent tasks centered on product, game, UI, or design work.
opportunities.timeSaved: Repeatable QA instead of manual reconstruction

opportunities.title: Research brief factory
opportunities.summary: Reuse a citation, glossary, argument-map, and action-summary structure for recurring study and analysis work.
opportunities.evidence: 18 recent tasks involved research, briefs, structured learning, or case analysis.

opportunities.title: Translation desk
opportunities.summary: Remember preferred languages, tone, terminology, and output shape without storing sensitive source text.
opportunities.evidence: 8 recent tasks involved translation or language work.
opportunities.timeSaved: Fewer repeated tone and terminology corrections
